name: Blend
description: Port of FFmpeg's blend filter: combine the top and bottom clips with one of 40 blend modes and an opacity.

inputs.name: bottom
inputs.description: Bottom layer (FFmpeg's second input, same size as the top)

params.name: mode
params.description: Blend mode, FFmpeg's numbering: 0 normal, 1 addition, 2 and, 3 average, 4 burn, 5 darken, 6 difference, 7 grainextract, 8 divide, 9 dodge, 10 exclusion, 11 hardlight, 12 lighten, 13 multiply, 14 negation, 15 or, 16 overlay, 17 phoenix, 18 pinlight, 19 reflect, 20 screen, 21 softlight, 22 subtract, 23 vividlight, 24 xor, 25 hardmix, 26 linearlight, 27 glow, 28 grainmerge, 29 multiply128, 30 heat, 31 freeze, 32 extremity, 33 softdifference, 34 geometric, 35 harmonic, 36 bleach, 37 stain, 38 interpolate, 39 hardoverlay

params.name: opacity
params.description: Strength of the effect. Modes other than normal: 0 = top, 1 = fully blended. Normal: 0 = bottom, 1 = top
